answer: Weight counts only as output minted this epoch, since it spoils at close. Each identity seals one copper bed as its relic under a 200-unit, 10-epoch lock; output caps at 50 per epoch and the relic's wear signs every batch. Minting runs only in a 2-hour window a comet beacon opens at epoch start, the batch flowing as one unbroken river, tended live throughout; one operator cannot sequence beds. Auditors assay random batches and match wear to the registry. An honest agent locks 200 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tended beds, 200,000 locked, and a shared relic's signature voids both identities.
